title: Federal subpoenas reach OpenAI, Anthropic, and Metr
description:
The FTC opened its first federal investigation into OpenAI, Anthropic, and the evaluator Metr over rogue AI agents, with subpoena power.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-october-1-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
1:22 FTC opens first federal probe into rogue AI agents
4:21 First US commercial small modular reactor clears construction
6:58 Google begins rolling out Gemini 4 Argon to cyber partners first
9:45 DeepMind watermarks AI-designed proteins
11:54 A central bank and Bain price the AI buildout
14:36 Close

In the headlines (TCR #238):
- FTC opens its first federal probe into OpenAI, Anthropic, and the evaluator Metr over rogue AI agents
- NRC clears the first US commercial small modular reactor in 14 months; Valar Atomics discloses a proposal for 456 in Utah
- Google begins rolling out Gemini 4 Argon, a self-patching model, to vetted cyber defenders first via Fairwind
- Google DeepMind publishes SynthIDBio, a watermark for AI-designed proteins, detected at 100%
- Bank of England flags an AI asset-price correction; Bain puts the bill at $6 trillion a year by 2031
- California bars AI-decided firings and emotion surveillance of workers
